whatIsRohini.title: What is ROHINI?
whatIsRohini.description: ROHINI (Registry of Hospitals in Network of Insurers) is a centralised registry of hospitals and day-care medical centres participating in the cashless health insurance network in India. Developed and maintained by the Insurance Information Bureau of India (IIB)—an initiative promoted by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)—each registered facility receives a globally unique 13-digit GS1-based identifier with verified geocoded location data.

whoNeedsIt.title: Who Needs ROHINI Registration?
whoNeedsIt.description: All hospitals, nursing homes, and day-care centres that currently offer or intend to offer cashless hospitalisation claims under health insurance policies are expected to maintain an active registration on the ROHINI registry per regulatory directives.

registrationSteps.title: Online Portal Application
registrationSteps.description: Submit facility profile, state medical registration details, clinical establishment certificate, and geocoded premises coordinates directly through the official IIB ROHINI portal.

registrationSteps.title: IIB Verification & Review
registrationSteps.description: The Insurance Information Bureau evaluates submitted facility data, institutional accreditations, and establishment credentials.

registrationSteps.title: Subscription Payment
registrationSteps.description: Remit the prescribed subscription payment to IIB (subscription is periodic; institutional fees are set directly by IIB).

registrationSteps.title: 13-Digit ROHINI ID Allocation
registrationSteps.description: Upon verification, IIB assigns the unique 13-digit identifier, publishing the facility in the national insurer network registry.

registrationSteps.title: Periodic Renewal
registrationSteps.description: Maintain active listing through periodic renewal before term expiry to prevent disruptions to cashless network claims.

cashlessEmpanelment.title: Cashless Network Empanelment
cashlessEmpanelment.description: Individual general insurers, standalone health insurers, and Third Party Administrators (TPAs) empanel medical facilities into their cashless provider networks at their independent discretion. Empanelment criteria and tariff structures vary by insurer and TPA.
cashlessEmpanelment.note: Requirements vary by insurer and TPA. Empanelment decisions remain at the sole discretion of each insurer or TPA.

faqs.question: What is a ROHINI ID?
faqs.answer: A ROHINI ID is a unique 13-digit identification code based on globally unique GS1 standards assigned to hospitals and day-care centres in India. It is generated by the Insurance Information Bureau of India (IIB) to uniquely identify healthcare facilities across insurer and Third Party Administrator (TPA) databases.

faqs.question: Is ROHINI registration mandatory for cashless claims?
faqs.answer: Yes. Regulatory guidelines from IRDAI expect hospitals and day-care centres participating in cashless health insurance networks to be registered on the central ROHINI database maintained by IIB.

faqs.question: Who maintains the ROHINI registry?
faqs.answer: The registry is developed and operated by the Insurance Information Bureau of India (IIB), an independent body promoted by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI).

faqs.question: Does having a ROHINI ID guarantee empanelment with insurers?
faqs.answer: No. ROHINI registration is a prerequisite identifier, but empanelment into a cashless network is strictly at the individual discretion of each insurance company and TPA based on their geographic network needs, tariff negotiations, and clinical standards.

faqs.question: What documents are usually needed for cashless empanelment?
faqs.answer: Insurers typically request your 13-digit ROHINI ID, Clinical Establishments Act registration (or state equivalent), hospital PAN copy, cancelled bank cheque, current tariff schedule, facility and staffing profile, and where available, NABH/NABL accreditation or application acknowledgement. Requirements vary by insurer.

faqs.question: How long does the registration process take?
faqs.answer: The timeline depends on the completeness of your documentation and verification by the Insurance Information Bureau of India (IIB). Contact our team to review your document readiness before submission.

faqs.question: Can medical day-care centres register on ROHINI?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dedicated day-care centres (such as dialysis units, eye care surgical clinics, and chemotherapy day centres) that perform procedures covered under health insurance policies are eligible to apply for ROHINI registration.

faqs.question: How do ROHINI renewals work?
faqs.answer: ROHINI registration requires periodic renewal with IIB before the expiry of the subscription period to ensure facility credentials and operating details remain updated in the insurer network.

disclosures.boxText: ROHINI registration is carried out by the Insurance Information Bureau of India (IIB). Empanelment decisions rest entirely with each individual insurer and TPA. Lotus Capital provides documentation guidance and coordination assistance and does not guarantee registration, empanelment approval, or turnaround timelines. Statutory fees, if any, are determined and collected directly by the respective authorities.
